Q0593

“Prophecy is an overflow from God through the intermediation of the Active…” — Maimonides (Q0593)

An English quotation associated with Guide of the Perplexed II.36 (Pines), organized here under faith.

Quotes / Maimonides / Q0593

English

Prophecy is an overflow from God through the intermediation of the Active Intellect, first to the rational faculty and then to the imaginative faculty.
Thinker Maimonides
School Jewish Rationalism
Source Guide of the Perplexed II.36 (Pines)
Theme Faith
Another quotation More from this thinker

Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with Guide of the Perplexed II.36 (Pines), within the Jewish Rationalism tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of faith, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Maimonides's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
